question_en: When does my current residence permit expire?
What is the latest date by which I have to apply for the extension?
question_de: Bis wann muss ich die Verlängerung spätestens beantragen?
reference_answer: By 5 September 2026, i.e. eight weeks before the permit expires.

question_en: How much is the processing fee and when do I have to pay it?
question_de: Was kostet die Bearbeitung und wann muss ich bezahlen?
reference_answer: 96.00 euros, payable when the application is submitted.

question_en: How much money do I need to prove that I can support myself?
question_de: Wie viel Geld muss ich zur Finanzierung meines Lebens nachweisen?
reference_answer: A blocked account with at least 11,904 euros, or a formal obligation (Verpflichtungserklärung) under § 68 AufenthG.

question_en: For how much longer does my passport need to be valid?
question_de: Wie lange muss mein Reisepass noch gelten?

question_en: Which document can I use to show that I have adequate housing?
question_de: Womit belege ich, dass ich eine passende Wohnung habe?

question_en: Under which section of the Residence Act is the permit for studying granted?
question_de: Auf welchem Paragraphen beruht die Aufenthaltserlaubnis für das Studium?

question_en: How do I book an appointment with the immigration office?
question_de: Wie bekomme ich einen Termin bei der Behörde?
reference_answer: Only online, through the city of Musterstadt's appointment portal.

question_en: Can I just come by without an appointment?
question_de: Kann ich auch einfach so ohne Termin vorbeikommen?
reference_answer: No, visiting without an appointment is not possible; an in-person visit is mandatory but requires an appointment.
gold_evidence: Vorsprache ohne Termin ist nicht möglich

question_en: What happens if I miss the application deadline?
question_de: Was passiert, wenn ich die Frist für den Antrag verpasse?
reference_answer: Legal residence ends when the permit expires, and a late application can lead to rejection.

question_en: How many days per year am I allowed to work alongside my studies?
question_de: Wie viele Tage im Jahr darf ich neben dem Studium jobben?
reference_answer: 140 full days or 280 half days per year.

question_en: Does a job as a student assistant at my university count towards that limit?
question_de: Zählt ein Hiwi-Job an meiner Uni zu dieser Grenze dazu?
reference_answer: No, it is not counted and is allowed without limit, but it must be reported to the office.

question_en: When can I reach the office by phone?
question_de: Zu welchen Zeiten kann ich das Amt anrufen?
gold_evidence: montags bis donnerstags von 8:00 bis 12:00 Uhr
